title: GitHub - laikacms/decap-cms: A Git-based CMS for Static Site Generators
excerpt: A Git-based CMS for Static Site Generators. Contribute to laikacms/decap-cms development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
This repository is a pnpm workspace. The actual CMS - @laikacms/decap-cms, a single-package fork of Decap CMS - lives in packages/decap-cms, which has the full README covering what the fork is, how it differs from upstream, and how to use it.

Install

npm install @laikacms/decap-cms

The root export bootstraps the classic app. Individual parts (backends, widgets, the core engine, UI primitives, plus the tree-shakeable @laikacms/decap-cms/app/bare and .../laika-app/bare entries) are importable through subpath exports so you can assemble your own build. See the package README for usage, visual editing, and the config JSON Schema.

Documentation

  • Package README - installation, usage, visual editing, and the config JSON Schema
  • Decap CMS documentation - configuration, content modeling, and backend setup; applies to this fork unless noted below
  • Breaking changes in v4.beta - how this fork differs from upstream
  • Laika backend notes - required reading if you use the laika backend
  • Contributing docs - design decisions and learnings behind the repo
  • CONTRIBUTING.md - development guide and release process
  • Releases / change log - every version, documented

Repository layout

packages/
  decap-cms/           the published @laikacms/decap-cms package (source, tests, demo, build)
  decap-cms-lib-pat/   scoped Personal Access Token minting/hashing/verification for Decap CMS servers
docs/
  contributing/  design decisions and learnings (see docs/contributing/index.md)
  base-ui/       Base UI primitive notes
  core/          core-engine notes

The workspace shape lets sibling packages (plugins, tooling, server pieces) live under packages/ alongside the main CMS package without another restructure, mirroring the layout of the laikacms/laikacms repo. The reasoning is documented in restructure.md.

Working in this repo

Everything runs from the root through pnpm:

pnpm install
pnpm test:ci      # lint + typecheck + unit tests, per package
pnpm build        # builds every package
pnpm build:dev-test && pnpm serve:dev-test   # demo app on http://localhost:5174, Laika UI on /laika.html

Repo-wide tooling (formatting via dprint, git hooks via husky, commit linting) lives at the root; each package is otherwise self-contained (its own tsconfig, ESLint config, tests, and build). See CONTRIBUTING.md for the development guide.

License

MIT

content_html_zh:
该存储库是一个 pnpm 工作区。 实际的 CMS - @laikacms/decap-cms，Decap CMS 的单包分支 - 位于 packages/decap-cms 中，其中包含完整的自述文件，涵盖分支是什么、它与上游有何不同以及如何使用它。

安装

npm install @laikacms/decap-cms

根导出引导经典应用程序。 各个部分（后端、小部件、核心引擎、UI 基元以及可摇树的 @laikacms/decap-cms/app/bare 和 .../laika-app/bare 条目）可通过子路径导出导入，以便您可以组装自己的构建。 有关使用、可视化编辑和配置 JSON 架构，请参阅包 README。

文档

  • 包自述文件 - 安装、使用、可视化编辑和配置 JSON 架构
  • Decap CMS 文档 - 配置、内容建模和后端设置；除非下面另有说明，否则适用于该前叉
  • v4.beta 中的重大变化 - 此分支与上游有何不同
  • Laika 后端说明 - 如果您使用 laika 后端，则需要阅读
  • 贡献文档 - 存储库背后的设计决策和学习
  • CONTRIBUTING.md - 开发指南和发布流程
  • 发布/更改日志 - 每个版本都有记录

存储库布局

packages/
  decap-cms/           the published @laikacms/decap-cms package (source, tests, demo, build)
  decap-cms-lib-pat/   scoped Personal Access Token minting/hashing/verification for Decap CMS servers
docs/
  contributing/  design decisions and learnings (see docs/contributing/index.md)
  base-ui/       Base UI primitive notes
  core/          core-engine notes

工作区形状允许同级包（插件、工具、服务器部分）位于包下/与主 CMS 包并排，无需再次重组，镜像 laikacms/laikacms 存储库的布局。 推理记录在restructor.md 中。

在此仓库中工作

一切都从 root 开始通过 pnpm 运行：

pnpm install
pnpm test:ci      # lint + typecheck + unit tests, per package
pnpm build        # builds every package
pnpm build:dev-test && pnpm serve:dev-test   # demo app on http://localhost:5174, Laika UI on /laika.html

存储库范围内的工具（通过 dprint 格式化、通过 husky 进行 git hooks、提交 linting）位于根；每个包都是独立的（它自己的 tsconfig、ESLint 配置、测试和构建）。 有关开发指南，请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md。

执照

MIT
